name: 新一代人工智能发展规划 (Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Development Plan, 2017)
owner: State Council of the People's Republic of China (中华人民共和国国务院)
description: Next Generation Artificial Intelligence Development Plan (Guofa [2017] No. 35, July 20, 2017). China's master national artificial intelligence strategy issued by the State Council on July 20, 2017 (Guofa [2017] No. 35), establishing three-step strategic milestones for 2020, 2025, and 2030 across AI R&D, industrial transformation, military-civil fusion, and three-stage AI legal and ethical governance.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by State Council of the People's Republic of China (中华人民共和国国务院) (gov.cn) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for State Council of the People's Republic of China (中华人民共和国国务院) (gov.cn).
